newsitem.title: JAPAN: SOCCER-LATE WINNER SECURES TOP SPOT FOR KASHIMA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LATE WINNER SECURES TOP SPOT FOR KASHIMA.

text.p: A late winner from substitute Atsushi Yanagisawa secured defending champions Kashima Antlers a 3-2 victory at Sanfrecce Hiroshima on Saturday and the top spot in the Japanese J-League.
Atsushi Yanagisawa struck from close range in the 84th minute to seal the win and give Kashima a one-point lead over second-placed Yokohama Flugels who lost 1-0 to city rivals Yokohama Marinos.
Brazilian Jorginho and Yasuo Manaka had put Kashima 2-0 ahead after just 28 minutes into the game but Hiroshima drew level with goals from Takuya Takagi and Masato Fue, setting up a tense finish.
In Yokohama, the Marinos' Spanish forward Julio Salinas scored a brilliant individual goal in the 68th minute to clinch victory.
